_calibration_notes: THIS LANE EXISTS FOR ONE REASON: the stub-deck lane surfaced ZERO relations, so the
founder-visible contradiction path -- select(), the tolerance and materiality rules, the
ordering by relative wrongness, and the rendering -- was untested against a real model.
A deck whose numbers agree cannot exercise it at all.
The deck carries two deliberate contradictions, verified through the real producers
offline before this lane was ever run: 412 x $95/month = $39,140 against a stated $22K
MRR (~78% relative), and 1,200,000 x $1,200 = $1.44B against a stated $1,800MM TAM
(~20%). Both above any materiality floor, ~4x apart in wrongness so their ORDER is a
test rather than an accident.
surfaced_contradictions_min is 1, NOT 2, and the floor is deliberate. Whether the
extraction sub-agent proposes both relations is model-dependent and has never been
measured on this fixture; the offline probe proves the ENGINE surfaces both when both
are proposed, which is a different claim. Asserting 2 would red the lane on proposal
variance rather than on a defect. The observed count is printed either way, so the floor
can be tightened once two runs have been seen -- the same rule the stub lane's own notes
set for its score floor.
Ordering is asserted only when at least two contradictions surface, for the same reason.
score_pct ceiling raised to 70 vs the stub's 65: this deck has 7 slides including a real
market slide, so more criteria can pass. Floor left at 10 -- a deck that contradicts
itself twice should not score well, and how an LLM weighs that has not been measured.
Foobar Systems is fictional. No real founder or company data.
